title: 雪の華 (Yukino Hana) / JISOO (BLACKPINK ARENA TOUR 2018 ”SPECIAL FINAL IN KYOCERA DOME OSAKA”)
lyrics_trans: [Black Pink "Snow Flower / JISOO (BLACKPINK ARENA TOUR 2018 "SPECIAL FINAL IN KYOCERA DOME OSAKA")" Lyrics] [Verse 1: Jisoo] A line of stretchy people on the pavement, walking with you in the evening, holding hands and forever If I could stay by my side, I would cry [Pre-Chorus: Jisoo] The wind was getting cold and I could smell winter It's about time for this town to get closer to you [Chorus: Jisoo] This year, the first snow flower is cuddled with excitement, and I'm not weak. But I love you I truly thought so [Verse 2: Jisoo] I feel like I can get through anything when you're there I hope these days will continue forever [Pre-Chorus: Jisoo] The wind shaking the windows, the nights shaking, and any sadness I'll turn to smile [Chorus: Jisoo] The falling snow blossoms will dye our towns, without knowing that it will fall, I learn that love is the kind of thing that makes me want to do something for someone else [Bridge: Jisoo] If I had lost you, I would turn into a star and shine you, even on the nights we were wet with tears, and I'll always be by my side [Chorus: Jisoo] This year, we were both cuddled with our first snow blossoms. It's overflowing with excitement, it's not that you're being spoiled or weak, but I want to stay with you forever, and honestly I feel that way [Outro: Jisoo] The pure white snow flower that piles up on this city I'll gently draw memories in the hearts of our two people, and forever, forever with you...
